timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per WSJ, stock futures fell as the fallout from Nvidia's leadership change continued to weigh on markets, while longer-dated Treasurys continued to sell off ahead of key U.S. inflation data (6:19 AM ET). WSJ reported the dollar rose to a 19-month high on rate-hike bets (6:21 AM ET), and that Asia's tentative tech rebound faded Friday as Nvidia uncertainty lingered (2:09 AM ET). Bloomberg reported Treasury yields surged over the week, with investors warning the bond rout is not over (1:00 AM ET), and that the IEA sees the global oil market swinging to a surplus as Gulf exports recover (4:00 AM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

calendar.text: U.S. inflation data due; WSJ reports investors are looking to the release as futures trade lower.

cryptoDriver.text: CoinDesk reported that Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep a $64 million Aave loan healthy.

items.headline: Nvidia 8-K: Jensen Huang resigns as CEO and director; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
items.summary: In an 8-K (Item 5.02) accepted Nov 12 at 8:52 AM ET, Nvidia said its board accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang as President, CEO and director effective immediately on Nov 11. CFO Colette M. Kress, who remains CFO, was appointed interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent CEO, and Harvey C. Jones, a director since 1993, was appointed Chair.

items.headline: Nvidia Tumbles as its CEO Jensen Huang Departs Amid Multiplying Scandals
items.summary: Per WSJ, Nvidia shares fell after CEO Jensen Huang's departure, while competitors AMD and Broadcom advanced and yields rose. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Nvidia Starts Search for Next CEO
items.summary: Per WSJ, Nvidia has begun a search for its next chief executive. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Before His Ouster, Jensen Huang Belittled the Executive Replacing Him
items.summary: Per WSJ, interim CEO Colette Kress has questioned some of Huang's dealmaking, and he had called her "a deer in the headlights." Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Banned Nvidia Chips Installed at China Data Center Linked to Alice Huang
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, a Chinese company founded by Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the controversy dogging Nvidia, procured smuggled AI chips. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Singapore Charges Fifth Person as Nvidia Fraud Case Expands
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, Singapore charged a fifth person in a fraud case linked to the export of computer hardware suspected of containing Nvidia chips. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Jensen Huang Exit Sets Up US-China Showdown Over AI Chip Curbs
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, the fall of Jensen Huang has removed the industry's most prominent opponent of US chip controls. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: US lawmakers pile pressure on Lutnick as Nvidia scandal widens
items.summary: Per the Financial Times, legislators are demanding that the commerce secretary explain why he allowed chip sales to a company linked to an alleged Chinese spy. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.
